}}'''Famelle Juarde''' is a Taraboner [[Kin]] and a member of the [[Knitting Circle]],{{ref|{{twotc}}, Famelle Juarde}} initially based in [[Ebou Dar]] and later in [[Andor]].

== Appearance ==
She is slender and pretty, with large brown eyes and pale honey colored hair. She has no grey in her hair.

== Strenght and Abilities ==
Her ''[[saidar]]'' level of strength is revealed to be {{opsl|44}} in the [[Wheel of Time Companion]], making her strong enough to be tested for Aes Sedai (but in a middle-low rank in their hierarchy).

This strength is not enough to open suitable gateways for [[traveling]].

== History ==
Born in {{ne|658}}, Famelle is 342 years old, one of the oldest living people in WOT series. She went to the White Tower in {{ne|672}} and spent eleven years as a novice.

She was put out of the Tower after refusing to complete her test for [[Accepted]]; in fact she refused to go into the third arch.

She later became for a while a goldsmith in Ebou Dar.

== Activities ==

She is one of Kin that accompanies [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] to the Rahad to find the [[Bowl of the Winds]]. She only just survives when the ''[[gholam]]'' attacks.

She [[Traveling|Travels]] with the rest of the group led by Nynaeve and Elayne from Ebou Dar to the Kin's [[farm]] with the Bowl of the Winds.

She, along with the rest of the group, travels to [[Caemlyn]] and now resides there.
